#fyp #roulette #casino #probability #oddsvisualized
yt_title: Red 26 Times in a Row Is 1 in 137 Million (It Happened in 1913)
yt_description:
Same color in a row on a European roulette wheel (18 of 37 pockets): 5 in a row 1 in 37, 10 in a row 1 in 1,347, 26 in a row 1 in 137 million. In 1913 at Monte Carlo, black came up 26 times in a row.
Each spin is still 18 in 37. YES or NO: would you bet after 10 reds?

Source: roulette math; Monte Carlo Casino, August 18, 1913.
